item.title: Not sure if this is correct dept to report to FOOTWAY IMPASSABLE, 1st November
item.description:
This serious problem has been reported countless times over several years!!!. The hedge of 45 Littlemead is so overgrown that the footway is blocked. Concrete fence posts are broken and falling forward. There are many people with disabilities who use this stretch and are forced into the road to carry on their journey. The property is privately owned, I’m told and the owner does not live there. Treat as URGENT, please. No reply from councillors. Chief Executive is my next step. Thank you.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Littlemede, Eltham
Report on FixMyStreet
